design: Male, about 65 years old, African-American, a deep warm low voice with some gravel, unhurried, an old mechanic who keeps everyone going, steady and fatherly, a grown man's chest voice, close-mic, clean dry studio audio, natural and conversational, not an announcer.
refText: Radio's been quiet since noon. I keep the batteries warm, I keep the antenna up, and I keep listening. Somebody's always out there. You just have to be patient with the static.
